name: r1-silu-bw-cluster2-small
author: solx-loop
description: Launching the one-shot kernel as clusters of 2 (compile-time __cluster_dims__, grid padded to an even count) lowers the per-launch span by about 0.15-0.2 us on B200 at every size with a grid of 1184 CTAs or fewer. 32-bit index math, constant L2 policies and a branch-free tail change nothing measurable. Dispatch is on n only.
